summary: Wave 2 (Dec 2026 Refit) tested end-to-end. Backend 402 trial-expired enforcement, read endpoints, and trial email subjects all verified. Frontend ToolHero strip, removed SD escape, updated CTA copy + clay button, larger preview frame, Pricing-page Free-plan removal, /signup?plan=free redirect, and the new hard PaywallModal (mounts via window event, blocks backdrop, no close button) all confirmed visually. TrialCountdownBanner code statically verified — render path requires a live trialing user (not present in test seed).
critical_code_review_comments: Brief lists data-testid='tool-hero-aged-care-os' but the ToolHero component uses dynamic per-tool testids: 'tool-hero-budget-calculator', 'tool-hero-price-checker', etc. (implementation: ToolHero.jsx line 20 → `tool-hero-${toolKey}`). Implementation is sensible; the brief's testid string is the inaccurate one. Confirm test docs reference the dynamic pattern, not the literal 'aged-care-os' string.

_require_paid_plan applies a per-IP burst limit (10/hour) BEFORE the trial check, so once a tester (or an unlucky shared-NAT real user) crosses the threshold they get 429 with no path to upgrade — same IP can never see the 402+modal flow until the bucket cools. Consider running the burst check AFTER the trial-expired gate so the paywall always takes priority. Encountered during test runs: had to flush redis tools_unauth_ip keys mid-suite.

TrialCountdownBanner is wired in Layout.jsx but has no live trialing user in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (the listed `trial30909@example.com` is now subscription_status='expired'). For repeatable regression coverage, seed a fresh `trial_active@example.com` with trial_ends_at = now()+5d on next run.

context_for_next_testing_agent:
Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_wave2_trial_paywall.py (7 tests, 100%). Note the rate-limit bucket: `tools_unauth_ip` per-IP allows only 10/hour. If you see 429s on /api/public/budget-calc during testing, run: `cd /app/backend && python -c "import asyncio, sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); from dotenv import load_dotenv; load_dotenv(); import rate_limit as rl; async def m():
  r=await rl._get_redis()
  async for k in r.scan_iter('*tools_unauth_ip*'): await r.delete(k)
asyncio.run(m())"` — or just wait an hour. PaywallModal is triggered via custom event 'wayly:trial-expired' dispatched by the axios 402 interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js. To test the modal manually: log in (any user), then in devtools console: `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wayly:trial-expired',{detail:{}}))`.
